channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio e o filme
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro received R$16 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about his father, but 89.1% of respondents believe he will never account for the funds. Most readers doubt any transparency regarding the money.

item.title: Lula reúne Motta e Alcolumbre para avançar pautas do governo
item.description: President Lula meets with the presidents of the Chamber and Senate to advance agendas such as the MP ending the 'suitcases tax' and the 6 X 1 scale. The provisional measure, which still charges ICMS on international purchases, must be approved by September 8th. The meeting aims to jointly announce the end of taxation.

item.title: Ativa nas redes, amiga de Lulinha exibia proximidade com ministros
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, a lobbyist and friend of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, displayed photos on social media with various ministers and authorities, suggesting closeness to the Lula administration. She faces investigations into alleged corruption, influence peddling, and money laundering.

item.title: ‘Já não temos muita esperança’, diz Paulo Galo às vésperas de julgamento no STF
item.description: Paulo Galo, app delivery worker and movement leader, expresses distrust in institutions ahead of a Supreme Court hearing on labor rights. The case involves Uber and debates whether an employment relationship exists between platforms and workers. Galo highlights achievements from strikes, such as the minimum delivery fee increase from R$ 5 to R$ 7.50.

item.title: Poder360 lança o Poder História: fatos relevantes do Brasil e do mundo
item.description: Poder360 launches Poder História, an editorial section documenting historical events related to politics, economy, and power in Brazil and worldwide, featuring facts, anniversaries, and editorial changes. The initiative includes free access to the Time Machine, which archives front pages since 2000. It also offers Poder Drive, a subscription-based platform for corporate decision-makers to analyze strategic public issues.

item.title: Deus, chapéu de couro e abraço a mãe: como foi 1º ato de Flávio no Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) launched his campaign in the Northeast with a visit to Maceió, where he wore a leather hat alongside running mate Alfredo Gaspar. During the event, he made religious statements, attacked Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and promised, vaguely, to transform the region's economy. The approach mixed symbolic gestures with criticism of the former president, without detailing concrete policies.

item.title: Lula e Flávio mostram o esgotamento dos debates
item.description: The first 2026 presidential debate, broadcast by Band, was marked by superficiality and a lack of substantive content. Of the six invited candidates, only Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos, and others made meaningful interventions, while Lula and Flávio remained defensive and failed to present concrete proposals.

item.title: Campanha na TV: As estratégias dos principais nomes nos 3 maiores Estados
item.description: In a heated presidential race with risks of a first-round conclusion, the performance of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the three largest electoral colleges in Brazil — São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro — becomes decisive for the national outcome. TV campaigns will play a central role in attracting undecided voters and mobilizing party bases.

item.title: O almoço decisivo para o fim definitivo da 'taxa das blusinhas'
item.description: Lula, Davi Alcolumbre, and Hugo Motta meet to announce the end of taxation on T-shirts. The measure aims to reduce the tax burden on basic clothing items.

item.title: ‘Faz o L?’: o que realmente significa o nome dado pela PF à operação sobre Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police (PF) named 'Faz o L?' an operation investigating suspected influence peddling involving Fábio Luís da Silva, son of President Lula. The name sparked surprise and concern behind the scenes of the INSS investigation, fueling debates about press coverage and the public image of political figures. The report highlights the tension between institutional power and judicial probes in the Brazilian electoral landscape.

item.title: Caso Lulinha vira munição contra indicação de Jorge Messias ao STF
item.description: The 'Lulinha case' is used to criticize the nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, after he rejected a PF request to challenge decisions by Minister André Mendonça. The incident caused tension between institutions and is leveraged by Messias' allies to question his performance.

item.title: Anúncios eleitorais descumprem regras do TSE e miram Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro e STF
item.description: Paid political ads on social media have been circulating since the start of the 2026 election campaign, many violating TSE rules by attacking opponents and institutions such as Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and the STF. This reflects challenges faced by the TSE in monitoring and removing irregular content promptly, as well as weak sanctions to prevent further violations.

item.title: PL usa fundação do partido para turbinar caixa em ano eleitoral
item.description: The PL, party of Flávio Bolsonaro, would have used the Alvaro Valle Institute to increase its electoral funding in election years, exploiting gaps in legislation. Between 2023 and 2026, the mechanism would have generated $115 million for the party, equivalent to 70% of all returns from other parties.

item.title: Por que mulheres e homens votam cada vez mais diferente — e como isso pode definir eleição entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Women, the majority of voters, are increasingly splitting their votes differently from men, favoring Lula while Flávio Bolsonaro faces challenges from inheriting his father's rejection. This gender voting divide could be decisive in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Flávio mira Michelle e Tarcísio ao defender fim da reeleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocates for the end of re-election to mobilize right-wing leaders, including Michelle Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Nikolas Ferreira, in his 2026 presidential campaign. Strategies aim to align interests, but the three have future presidential projects, limiting their current engagement.

item.title: “Emendas são extravagância fiscal”, diz coordenador de Caiado
item.description: Roberto Brant, coordinator of Ronaldo Caiado's government plan, advocates fiscal adjustment with expenditure ceiling and criticized parliamentary amendments as 'fiscal extravagance'. The plan aims for fiscal balance within one year with progressive surplus until 2030.

item.title: Após encontro discreto com Lira, Flávio faz 2º dia de giro por AL sem JHC
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro continued his second day of campaigning in Alagoas without publicly meeting JHC and Arthur Lira, focusing on events with supporters and business leaders. A discreet meeting with Lira occurred during a religious service, while the strategy avoids direct exposure to protect the local candidates’ own races.

item.title: Novo salário mínimo reajusta benefícios e impacta contas públicas. Entenda
item.description: The federal government projects the minimum wage at R$1,741 for 2027, a 7.4% increase from the current R$1,621. The adjustment affects various social benefits and public expenditures, including pensions, BPC, unemployment insurance, and contributions from self-employed workers and individual micro-entrepreneurs, increasing mandatory budget expenses. The impact is already included in the 2027 Budget Bill, to be sent to Congress by August 31st.

item.title: Lula se reúne com Motta e Alcolumbre por taxa das blusinhas e prioridades
item.description: President Lula meets with Congressional leaders to discuss approval of the Provisional Measure eliminating import tax on international purchases up to $50, known as the 'blusinhas tax', before its expiration deadline of September 8th. The meeting aims to secure congressional support to prevent the tax from returning, which could negatively impact Lula's reelection campaign.

item.title: Raquel Lyra x João Campos: mapa indica quem "controla" cada cidade de PE
item.description: Map data shows Raquel Lyra leads with 139 city endorsements versus João Campos' 40. A Quaest poll indicates a statistical tie in voter intentions. Municipal support reflects strategic party alliances.

item.title: A armação fake de Bia Kicis: vídeo cortado e ataque vil a Lula
item.description: Federal congresswoman Bia Kicis (PL-DF), pre-candidate for the Senate in the Federal District, was criticized for manipulating a video of President Lula to label him an atheist. The episode was repudiated on Noblat's show, with accusations of dishonesty and misleading manipulation to win votes.

item.title: Mendonça é o ministro que menos vota a favor da campanha de Lula no TSE, aponta levantamento
item.description: TSE data shows Minister Mendonça voted against Lula's campaign in 70% of cases from February to August 2026, making him the least aligned minister with the PT campaign's requests in the electoral court.

item.title: A manobra de Alexandre de Moraes após sair derrotado em julgamento do 8/1
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, rapporteur for the investigations into the January 8 coup attempts, removed from the virtual plenary agenda two cases that allowed defendants to deduct custodial measures from their prison sentences. This move follows a rare defeat in the Supreme Court's full bench on the same issue, amid an electoral dispute reigniting debates on penalties for those involved. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Quaest para o governo de SP: veja intenção de voto por renda, sexo, idade, escolaridade, cor, religião e posicionamento político
item.description: Quaest poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading with 40% and Fernando Haddad with 27% of voting intentions for São Paulo governor. Tarcísio leads in most demographics, particularly among evangelicals and whites, while Haddad ties technically among black voters.

item.title: Kassio avalia desistir de selo para instituto de pesquisas na eleição de 2026 após críticas
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques considers abandoning the accuracy seal proposal for election polling institutes in 2026 due to backlash. The initiative aimed to reward companies whose polls closely matched actual vote results.

item.title: Zema reduz ataques a Flávio para evitar novos atritos com PL e tenta diversificar pautas de olho no eleitorado à direita
item.description: Zema reduces attacks on Flávio Bolsonaro to avoid conflicts with PL, focusing on criticisms of STF and new flags such as the end of bets and rights of app workers.

item.title: Sem marqueteiro, Renan Santos aposta em 'guerrilha digital' e mira em bancada de deputados do partido
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from the Missão party for president, is using a 'digital guerrilla' strategy without a marketing consultant, relying on viral social media content to boost his campaign and that of candidates for deputies. He caused controversy by bringing underwear with the names of Lula and Flávio and using insults during debates, following Pablo Marçal's style. His campaign sees the upcoming interview on the Jornal Nacional as a key moment, aiming to leverage TV Globo's reach, with 4% support in the latest Datafolha poll.

item.title: Lula se reúne com Motta e Alcolumbre e reforça aproximação com cúpula do Congresso por cartada eleitoral
item.description: President Lula meets with Congress leaders to strengthen political alliances ahead of the 2026 elections, pushing for approval of key measures such as the end of foreign purchase taxes and the PEC eliminating 6x1 work shifts. The meeting aims to improve coordination between the executive and legislative branches during a critical electoral period.

item.title: O GLOBO, Valor e CBN sabatinam Ronaldo Caiado com transmissão ao vivo em série de entrevistas com presidenciáveis
item.description: O GLOBO, Valor, and CBN are hosting live presidential candidate interviews in 2026, broadcast on radio, websites, and YouTube. The first interview features Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) at 10:30 AM Brasília time, lasting one and a half hours. Other confirmed guests include Romeu Zema, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury, while Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro have not yet confirmed participation.

item.title: Flávio escala Marinho para ajustar palanques e buscar doações pelo país, em estados fora de sua agenda
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro appointed Rogério Marinho to coordinate political alliances, fundraising, and outreach in states outside his electoral schedule. Concerned about the division of the electoral fund, Marinho leads negotiations with business leaders and donors. His political expertise and close relationship with Jair Bolsonaro enhance his strategic role in the campaign.

item.title: Pastor ora por Flávio e pede que Brasil “não caia nas garras do inimigo”
item.description: During the 111th anniversary event of the Assembly of God in Alagoas, presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) received prayers asking that Brazil not fall 'into the hands of the enemy'. The event, also attended by Arthur Lira (PP-AL) and Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), raised concerns about the boundaries between religion and electoral campaigns. The Electoral Court has already annulled politicians in similar cases involving the use of religious services for campaign promotion.

item.title: Vaquinhas eleitorais já superam R$ 8 milhões; dez candidatos concentram metade das doações
item.description: Crowdfunding campaigns for the 2026 elections have already exceeded R$8.8 million, with half of the donations concentrated in just ten candidates. The preliminary data, sourced from four crowdfunding platforms, indicate strong digital engagement, particularly among politicians with significant social media presence.

item.title: Presidenciáveis defendem cooperação com países vizinhos e uso de tecnologia no combate ao crime nas fronteiras; veja propostas
item.description: The six best-polling presidential candidates presented proposals for cooperation with neighboring countries and the use of technology to combat organized crime at borders. Proposals include river and air patrols, investments in radars, drones, and artificial intelligence, as well as national border systems and inter-American operations centers. Public security, especially at border regions, is one of the population's main concerns.

item.title: Renan Santos participa de entrevista da Globo nesta quarta-feira; saiba como assistir
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate for president from the Missão party, participates this Wednesday (26) in the series of interviews conducted by TV Globo with candidates for the Presidency of the Republic in the 2026 elections. The interview, conducted by Renata Vasconcellos and César Tralli, will be broadcast live after the Jornal Nacional, starting at 9:05 PM (Brasília time), directly from the Globo Studios in Rio de Janeiro, and will also be aired by GloboNews and g1, with full availability later on Globoplay.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro estreia campanha no Nordeste em Alagoas sem JHC e com Lira apenas em culto
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro launched his Northeast campaign in Alagoas, emphasizing security and anti-crime rhetoric, but notable absences included JHC and Arthur Lira at most events.

item.title: Eleições 2026: presidenciáveis defendem contas em ordem para baixar juro e estimular economia, mas não detalham propostas
item.description: The main 2026 presidential candidates, including Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema, advocate fiscal adjustment and interest rate cuts to boost the economy, but lack specific proposals. While they agree high interest rates hinder growth, they differ on the intensity and approach of fiscal adjustment.

item.title: Quaest: veja os números da eleição para presidente em 17 estados e no DF
item.description: Quaest polls show a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro. Lula leads in Maranhão and Pernambuco, while Flávio leads in Santa Catarina and Rondônia. High rate of undecided and blank votes in Rio.

item.title: Ronaldo Caiado na Globo: o que disse o candidato à Presidência na entrevista à emissora
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, running for president with the PSD, defended in a TV Globo interview the pardon for those convicted in connection with the attempted coup in January 2023, saying it would help pacify the country and reduce political polarization. He also announced plans for a joint South American police force and a pension reform, though he avoided commenting on changes to the minimum retirement age. The interview is part of a series by the broadcaster featuring six presidential candidates.

item.title: Governo Trump suspende entrevistas para vistos de imigrantes
item.description: The Trump administration suspended immigrant visa interviews worldwide, affecting all countries including Brazil. The measure aims for stricter candidate evaluation to prevent them from becoming public charges, while non-immigrant visas remain normal. Already scheduled appointments were rescheduled and a future date will be communicated.

item.title: Mendonça propõe tese para definir deepfake e proibir conteúdos
item.description: TSE Vice-President Justice André Mendonça proposed a common definition for deepfakes in electoral campaigns, aiming to standardize understanding of AI usage in videos. In his ruling, Mendonça classified as deepfake content that creates false perception of authorship regarding statements or behaviors, prohibiting a video linking Daniel Vorcaro to Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula define equipe jurídica da campanha com foco nas redes sociais
item.description: Lula sets up legal team for reelection campaign, focusing on TSE actions against Flávio Bolsonaro and fighting misinformation on social media. The team is led by Angelo Ferraro and includes former TSE ministers.

item.title: Haddad pede investigação contra Jovem Pan por fake news e ataques a sua esposa
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) has requested an investigation by the Electoral Public Ministry against Jovem Pan for spreading a false claim attributing to him a statement about his wife and for making sexual attacks against her. The broadcaster reproduced, in its program, the false claim that Haddad would have said his wife 'would sleep with the next governor of São Paulo.' Haddad's lawyers request the recording of the program, audience data, the appearance of the presenters, and an investigation into possible abuse of power in communication during the electoral campaign.

item.title: Caiado rebate pergunta sobre reformas: “Não estamos numa mesa examinadora”
item.description: In an interview with Jornal Nacional, presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) avoided detailing his proposals for Social Security reform, saying 'we are not in an exam room.' He stated he intends to consult experts before presenting specific measures and reiterated he will not alter the minimum wage or cut constitutional floors for health and education. His stance drew criticism for lack of specificity.

item.title: Mendonça propõe tese sobre deepfakes e deve ter maioria no TSE
item.description: Minister André Mendonça, vice-president of the TSE, proposed a thesis to regulate the use of deepfakes in electoral campaigns, suggesting a ban when there is a risk of inducing false perception of authenticity. At least four ministers support a stricter stance, while TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques seems to lean toward adopting this interpretation after a recent defeat in the virtual plenary.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na entrevista de Ronaldo Caiado à Globo
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado gave an interview to Globo as part of a series with leading candidates. The Fato ou Fake team verified that two of his statements are #FACT: 82% of Brazilian families are in debt and 60 million live under drug trafficking influence.

item.title: Romeu Zema na Globo: o que disse o candidato à Presidência na sabatina da emissora
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential candidate, emphasized in his Globo interview the privatization of state-owned companies, classifying criminal factions as terrorist organizations, and pardoning those convicted for the January 8 events. The interview was the first of six with presidential candidates by the network.

item.title: Caiado defende que polícias de países vizinhos entrem no Brasil para combater facções
item.description: Caiado proposed partnerships with neighboring countries to combat criminal factions, allowing foreign police to enter Brazil. He also advocated for amnesty for those convicted in the January 8th events to promote national peace.

item.title: Entrevista de Ronaldo Caiado ao JN foi teste de resistência ao eleitor
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado's interview with the National News was marked by evasive answers and stumbles over data, highlighting difficulties in articulating a clear agenda. He avoided taking unpopular economic stances and drew criticism for referring to minimum wage recipients in a decontextualized manner.

item.title: O estado onde Flávio aparece 17 pontos à frente de Lula em pesquisa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads a Quaest poll in Mato Grosso with 43% voting intention, 17 points ahead of Lula (PT), who scored 26%. Conducted between August 21 and 24, 2026, the survey shows most voters have already decided. The margin of error is 3 percentage points.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro convoca ato para o 7 de Setembro na Avenida Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) called a rally on Paulista Avenue for September 7th, aiming to mobilize supporters and replicate the street strategy of the Bolsonaro movement. The campaign uses symbols linked to his father and mirrors traditional protest tactics in São Paulo.
